name: Network Diagnostics
description: Connection type (WiFi/Ethernet), WiFi signal, network outage history, gateway/target ping, and dashboard HTTP latency. Only the detailed WiFi SSID/BSSID/RSSI needs root — everything else needs none.
author: David Coulson

settings.title: Ping target
settings.description: Host or IP to measure round-trip latency and packet loss against, e.g. your Home Assistant server or router. Empty disables ping probing. Uses an unprivileged ICMP datagram socket — the same mechanism Android's own ping command uses, no root required.

settings.title: Probe interval
settings.description: How often to ping the configured target, ping the default gateway, and check the dashboard URL.

settings.title: Dashboard URL
settings.description: HTTP(S) URL to time a plain response from, as a rough stand-in for dashboard responsiveness — this plugin has no way to discover Kiosk Satellite's own configured URL, so provide one yourself (your Home Assistant server's URL works well). Measures time to receive response headers only, not a real page load. Empty disables this check.

settings.title: Simulation mode
settings.description: Test the controls without touching hardware or the network.
